paragraphs: R' Chanina, deputy of the priests. See the entry R' Chananya, deputy of the priests.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ס״הכ completes the target by repeating סגן הכהנים, “deputy of the priests,” from the heading. It does not mean “total” in this notice.
Chanina (חנינא) and Chananya (חנניה) remain distinct supplied forms. Hyman provides a cross-reference rather than an independent historical identity argument; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
